messages:
alex: quick follow-up from the postmortem — doing a concise action list to track remediation for the us-west autoscale/gpu capacity event.

alex: summary: quota spike exhausted Dedicated reserve, scheduler preemption churned pods, headroom briefly fell to ~6% and user requests queued for ~20m. PM doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/3321-autoscale-postmortem

priya: noted. main remediation candidates?

alex: shortlist — 1) request reserved GPUs / temporary burst capacity 2) scheduler tuning (preemption window + eviction weights) 3) headroom guardrail per-zone + alerting 4) recurring pattern investigation + synthetic burst validation

cory: i'll take recurring pattern analysis and synth test harness. ETA: produce anomaly report + test script by 2026-03-27. Script will run 10x baseline traffic against dedicated pool.

rama: scheduler tuning is on me. Plan: change preemption window to 30s in dev, lower eviction priority factor by 0.25, canary 10% us-west. Metrics to watch: eviction rate, restart count, P95 latency. PR by EOD tomorrow.

emily: i'll own headroom policy and alerting. i'll add dashboard cards and an alert: headroom <12% for 5m -> page on-call, and a secondary warning at 18% for ops slack. ETA: tomorrow morning.

alex: quota request owner?

emily: cloud quota requests typically owned by infra; tagging @cloud-ops here — emily will file initial request then handoff.

cloud-ops: saw the ping. We'll evaluate reserved vs burst credits. Please attach peak load curves to ticket. We can provision temporary buffer in ~48h if prioritized.

emily: filed ticket CLOUD-5730 with load graphs and cost note. Marked for expedited review.

cory: synth test script (planned):

```bash
# run synthetic burst against us-west dedicated pool
python infra/loadtest.py --region us-west --pool dedicated --concurrency 700 --duration 600
```

cory: will run this after scheduler canary completes and post results to PM doc.

priya: also adding recurrence column in action tracker and linking related incidents from the last 90 days. There are 3 similar spike events on a ~3-week cadence.

alex: ownership recap: CLOUD-5730 -> emily/cloud-ops; scheduler tuning -> rama; dashboard & alerts -> emily; synth tests & recurrence analysis -> cory; tracking + weekly check-ins -> alex.

ops-bot: Incident follow-up INC-2048 created. Follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC.

rama: noted — i'll upload scheduler traces and the canary run log to the PM doc within 24h of canary start.

emily: will add runbook steps for on-call for headroom alerts (escalation + immediate mitigations).

alex: timeline summary: emily files quota ticket (done), rama PR + canary tomorrow, emily dashboards before canary, cory runs synth tests after canary, alex will update tracker and lead weekly follow-ups. Mark items resolved here when done and paste PR/ticket links. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
